title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: After Kanmani's return, Anbu vows to win her love again. Vennila orders the maid to spoil her food, but Kanmani notices the attempt and saves it before it falls.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi finds Nalani and attempts to escape, but Sidharth locks them inside his friend's home. Meanwhile, Paraman notices Ilamathi is missing and sets out to find her.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna burns the original medical report containing details of Parvathy's death. Abinaya heads to court, as Prabhakaran panics after discovering the evidence against Karna is missing.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar confronts Pandian and gets him arrested by the police for kidnapping Poongodi. Conflict arises at home when Rasathi brings household essentials for Poongodi's separate kitchen.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar exposes Thangaraj, leaving Bagyaraj and Suresh stunned. Meanwhile, Mathi confronts Suresh, while Revathi grows worried over Thangaraj's request for a blood test.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian's harsh remark hurts Senthil, prompting him to leave the dinner midway. Senthil expresses regret to Kathir for his unintentional hurtful remarks, and the two reconcile.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila gets mad at Chozhan's chats, while Pandian and Pallavan warn Cheran to stay away from Karthika. Later, Pallavan hilariously wears Chandrayatha's anklet to mimic her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena and Muthu check out a new office for their business. Later, Annamalai plans a double wedding, while Muthu and Ravi mock Manoj's childish look.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Azhagar and Meenatchi celebrate their first birthday as both families visit the temple. Vellathai asks Tamizhselvi to let Meenatchi join Azhagar for food distribution.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Maran chases Karthik and Kasthuri into the forest and restrains Karthik. He takes Kasthuri away to proceed with the forced marriage, but her grandfather refuses to approve it.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan and his brothers hide their Biryani business from Kandhasamy. Their families go wedding shopping together, while Kandhasamy keeps clothing expenses within budget.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Whom Will The Judges Choose?
description: Parveen faces tough questions, while Manivannan touches hearts. Karishma's banters and Pugazhenthi's rare talent, leaves judges in a tough spot.
